title: ai-atoms agent v1
description: An agent atom — a bindable identity: one persona bound to the prompts, skills, tools, policies, and hooks it runs with, plus execution preferences. Actors execute work; reviewers judge work products. Every reference must resolve to an atom in the catalog.

id.description: Namespaced identifier in the form agent/<slug>.

version.description: Semantic version of this agent atom.

description.description: What this agent does, what it may touch, and what it must not.

subtype.description: actor = produces work products; reviewer = evaluates work products against review_criteria and emits verdicts.

persona.description: The persona atom this agent embodies.

prompts.description: Prompt atoms injected in order after the persona.

skills.description: Skill atoms this agent may invoke.

tools.description: Tool atoms exposed to this agent. Omit or leave empty for a read-only conversational agent.

policies.description: Policy atoms (capability grants, isolation, boundaries) enforced by the runtime for this agent.

hooks.description: Hook atoms wired into this agent's runtime.

planner.description: Reasoning loop shape the runtime should use.

memory.description: Memory model the runtime should provide.

supervisor.description: Agent id that supervises this one, or 'none'.

review_criteria.description: For subtype reviewer: the criteria verdicts are judged against.

authored_by.description: Key atom ID or author identifier.

source_url.description: URL of the original source when imported from an external repository.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle stage of this agent atom.
